    ROUND(CAST((CAST(df.successpct AS numeric) / (CAST(df.errtally + 1 AS numeric))) * (1 - CAST(df.rtrytally AS numeric) / (CAST(df.errtally + 1 AS numeric))) AS numeric), 2) AS data_flow_reliability_score,
    df.orignation || ' -> ' || df.destnation AS transfer_path
FROM dataflow df
JOIN dataprofile dp ON df.recordregistry = dp.flowsign
WHERE dp.intcheck = 'Failed' OR dp.csumverify = 'Failed'
ORDER BY data_flow_reliability_score ASC
LIMIT 10;
